title: Preparation, Mechanical Properties and Flame Retardancy of Phosphorus-containing Polyimide Fibers
washing_state: Prepared fibers after process washing baths; no durability laundering reported
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Table 2: TGA data and LOI values of the PI fibers; section 2.2 explicitly identifies PI1 through PI4 fiber residues at 800 °C.
source_material_form_LOI_raw: Section 2.3 and Table 2 identify LOI of PI1 through PI4 fibers; section 1.1 lists an oxygen-index tester.
treatment_chemistry: Table 1 molar ratio DAPPO:ODA:PMDA:BPDA = 0:100:70:30. DAPPO is bis(3-aminophenyl)phenylphosphine oxide; PI1 contains no DAPPO.
treatment_method: Table 1 supplies the individual DAPPO:ODA:PMDA:BPDA molar formulation. PMDA and BPDA were dried before use, ODA used directly and DMAc purified by reduced-pressure distillation. Section 1.2 reports PAA solution formation in DMAc at room temperature for 12 h, 15 wt% solids and inherent viscosity controlled to 1.8–2.5 dL/g. Solution placed in a 2 L spinning pot and left 12 h for degassing, then dry-jet wet spun at room temperature across a 2 cm air gap into a 33 wt% DMAc aqueous coagulation bath, jet stretch ratio 2.5 and subsequent draw ratio 1.5. Figure 1 identifies a 15 wt% DMAc/water washing bath and a second washing bath. PAA fibers thermally imidized at 50–300 °C with gradient heating over 8 h, then drawn 1–3 times at 480 °C to obtain PI fibers. The exact final draw ratio of each table row is not stated. These are the initial prepared fibers; no durability laundering reported.
TGA_specimen_preparation: Prepared PI fibers; no aliquot mass, cutting or grinding, pan, or TG preconditioning specified.
LOI_instrument: YG813 oxygen-index tester, Changzhou Second Textile Instrument Factory
LOI_locator: Published p.670, PDF p.4, Table 2 LOI column and section 2.3 repeat all four measured state values.
TG_locator: Published p.670, PDF p.4, Table 2 T5 and char yield at 800 °C; p.669, PDF p.3, section 2.2 repeats all residues and treated-state T5 values, with PI4 T5 conflict held.
conditions_locator: Published p.667, PDF p.1, section 1.1; pp.668–669, PDF pp.2–3, section 1.2, Figure 1 and Table 1.
pairing_evidence: Table 2 places the PI1 TG and LOI in one fiber-state row. Table 1 maps the same label to DAPPO:ODA:PMDA:BPDA 0:100:70:30. Both methods explicitly concern the synthesized spun PI fiber series, with process wash history shared. No film or bulk-polymer TG is used.
source_access_method: Original five-page journal PDF indexed text at the Science China/Sciengine primary host; all methods, results, conclusion and references read. Original PDF bytes and pixels unavailable.
limitations: The same Table 2 row reports both exact TG and measured LOI on PI fibers; the original explicitly names an oxygen-index tester and contains no char-to-LOI equation. LOI standard, specimen mounting or dimensions, replicate count, uncertainty and conditioning are not reported. The 20 mm sample length and 10 mm/min tensile speed in section 1.1 belong to the separate mechanical assay. TG specimen mass, pan, gas flow, acquisition endpoints and aliquot preparation are not reported. Indexed original text of all five pages was reviewed; direct original PDF bytes and page pixels were unavailable, and the evidence-cache SHA256 is not a PDF document hash. The general preparation paragraph includes an example with 0.03484 mol DAPPO and 0.3136 mol of an unnamed reagent in the extracted text; this is not assigned to any Table 1 row and the missing reagent label is not repaired. Individual recipes use the explicit Table 1 molar ratios. Exact final drawing within the reported 1–3 range is unresolved, but TG and LOI remain paired on the same source row. PI4 T5 is held because Table 2 says 541 °C and section 2.2 says 539 °C; its R800 of 66% is consistent across table and prose.

source_metric_holds: PI4 T5 541 °C table versus 539 °C prose is not canonical; all four R800 values agree with prose.
